answer: Alias foundries still cut unused keys from a single parent. To claim a seat, a claimant roasts a 62 g lotus seed lot until each kernel cracks at 168°C, then cools the lot on a 9-coil ripple plate whose current reverses every 40 seconds for 6 hours. Bond is 49 POA for 8 days. Three kiln-wardens re-weigh the lot to 0.15 g, replay the coil-current log, and reject any two crack thermograms whose cosine similarity exceeds 0.83. A second key that reuses a thermogram or leaves a coil-log gap longer than 90 seconds forfeits 58% of the bond and is barred for 6 epochs.
